name: complib
description: CompLib monorepo — Discover, preview, customize, assemble, export, and reuse UI components.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @complib/api && npm run build -w @complib/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @complib/contracts && npm run build -w @complib/taxonomy && npm run build -w @complib/entitlements && npm run build -w @complib/component-schema && npm run build -w @complib/component-registry && npm run build -w @complib/variant-engine && npm run build -w @complib/export-engine
